en.title: Defuse All Bombs Before Their Deadlines
en.description:
You can defuse only one bomb at a time and cannot interrupt it. Bomb i takes X[i] time and must be finished at or before time Y[i]. Time starts at 0. Find the minimum total time to defuse all bombs; if it is impossible, output −1.

This site has made the standard input and output explicit; any range not given by the source is marked as this site's protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of duration deadline. 1≤n≤200000; the source gives no time bounds, so on this site 1≤duration≤10⁹ and 1≤deadline≤10¹⁵.
en.explanation: Example 1: scheduling by deadline, the cumulative completion times 2, 3, 4, 8, 11 are all on time, so output 11. Example 2: the total time is 3, but both must be finished before 2, so output −1. Example 3: the work finishes exactly at deadline 3, so output 3.
hints: Process bombs in ascending order of deadline and accumulate durations; if at any point the total exceeds the current deadline there is no solution, otherwise the answer is the total duration.
